question: Can a preregistered blinded feature model distinguish historically connected flood traditions from matched independent or generic flood narratives without using tradition labels or modern translation vocabulary?

primary_hypotheses.H_diffusion: Some flood texts cluster because of textual ancestry or historical transmission.
primary_hypotheses.H_convergence: Some similarities arise independently from common flood experience and narrative convergence.
primary_hypotheses.H_overfit: Apparent clustering is produced mainly by analyst-selected motifs, translation vocabulary or label leakage.

seed_texts.source_gate: Acquire a philologically reliable edition/translation and preserve tablet/manuscript metadata. British Museum object 1889,0426.236 is an Old Babylonian Atrahasis flood witness dated to 1635 BC.
seed_texts.root_policy: Treat copies/fragments as manuscript witnesses within an Atrahasis textual family, not independent cultural attestations.

seed_texts.source_gate: Use Tablet XI with manuscript identifiers. British Museum K.3375 is a Neo-Assyrian 7th-century BC witness from the Library of Ashurbanipal.
seed_texts.root_policy: Keep Gilgamesh flood witnesses separate at manuscript level but collapse to textual-family level for independence counts.

seed_texts.source_gate: Encode Hebrew text with edition/version metadata and keep translation outputs secondary.
seed_texts.root_policy: Christian translations and later retellings do not create additional independent roots.

seed_texts.source_gate: Encode the relevant Arabic passages directly and record all passage boundaries before feature scoring.
seed_texts.root_policy: Test historical contact with Jewish, Christian and wider Late Antique traditions as an active null.

seed_texts.source_gate: Select and freeze the exact Sanskrit textual locus and edition before coding.
seed_texts.root_policy: Do not pool later Manu retellings as independent witnesses.

minimum_groups: geographically/culturally distant flood narratives with provenance
non-flood catastrophe narratives matched for genre
control_design.oral_tradition_rule: No community-controlled or oral sacred narrative enters the test without permission/provenance clearance. Absence is preferable to unauthorized extraction.
control_design.minimum_control_ratio: At least 2 controls per focal text before promotion of any classifier result.

feature_coding_rules: No feature value may be inferred from memory when the text locus is unavailable.
Unknown and damaged-text states remain UNKNOWN, not 0.
Broad concepts must not be harmonized across traditions without an ontology note.
A modern translation word match scores zero lexical evidence unless supported by original-language analysis.
Ordered bundles are scored only from explicit sequence in the frozen text locus.
Analysts coding features must not see the family label used by the scoring stage where practical.
analysis_plan: Freeze exact text loci, editions and feature schema.
Create anonymized IDs and remove tradition labels from coding/scoring packets.
Encode values independently where possible and preserve disagreements.
Compute similarity using generic features and rare-feature-weighted features separately.
Reveal chronology and geography only after initial clustering is frozen.
Construct contact graph and collapse known textual roots.
Re-score residual similarity after dependence/contact subtraction.
Run leave-one-text-out and leave-one-feature-family-out sensitivity checks.
Have Fast-CAT-style blinded review attack the strongest surviving bundle.
Issue PASS, HOLD, FAIL or NEGATIVE_CERTIFICATE; never force a survivor.
primary_success_condition: Before label reveal, the preregistered model distinguishes at least one historically supported transmission family from matched controls in a way that survives translation substitution, source-root collapse, shuffled nulls and leave-one-feature-family-out checks.
primary_failure_condition: Clustering disappears when labels, modern translation vocabulary, generic flood features, one analyst-selected feature family or duplicated textual roots are removed.
residual_success_condition: A rare ordered bundle remains between source roots with no currently supported dependence/contact explanation and also exceeds matched convergence controls.
residual_interpretation: UNRESOLVED_INDEPENDENT_RESIDUAL only. It is a target for another spiral, not evidence of revelation or supernatural causation.

external_anchor_receipts.use: Old Babylonian Atrahasis flood witness; museum dates it to 1635 BC
Gilgamesh Tablet XI flood witness; museum dates it to the 7th century BC
Hebrew text/version surface; exact edition and license metadata remain mandatory
